g.text: Hold challenges constant during the race. Read after Done and settling; discard the result if Invalid = 1.
A saturated counter holds 65,535 until reset. No reference clock or synchronizer is used.
The equality flag identifies equal final counts; it is not a general detector of metastability or measurement noise.
